depicts: Low camera view down a corridor between tall dark concrete walls; three small armored fighters, one lying down, in the distance; a yellow grid overlay covers the foreground floor.
composition: Subject fighters are small and sit centre, just above the lower third; the walls take the left and right thirds; the yellow grid fills the lower third. Sky gap at top centre.
